description: 堺市 防災トイレのある公園一覧 [fire, police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 堺市. 堺市の防災トイレのある公園一覧です。. Coverage: 堺市. The portal files it under the publisher 堺市. Its tags are トイレ, 一覧, 位置情報, 便所, 災害. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
